note: P0 ACCESS CONTROL. Enforces the closed-beta invite at ACCOUNT CREATION.
Measured on production 2026-08-23: 8 accounts, 3 consumed invites - the
gate had never been enforced anywhere. Adds an AFTER INSERT trigger on
auth.users that consumes an unused code atomically with the user row, plus
public.hr_signup_gate(jsonb) for registration as the Supabase
before-user-created auth hook (ops step, see the file's tail).
LAST in the order for two reasons: it reads public.hr_rate_ok (created
earlier in the chain) and it revokes claim_beta_invite, which
2026-08-10-dr-beta-invites-base.sql grants. Running it before that file
would have the grant put back underneath it.
Its self-check inserts probe rows into auth.users and deletes them again,
asserting auth.users and the consumed-invite count are byte-identical
afterwards. It sets hearthrise.invite_gate_force so the probe is not waved
through by the operator bypass - verified by mutation: without that line
SELF-CHECK 1 fails, and without the `used_by is null` predicate SELF-CHECK
